dialogue.origin: 今日はお時間をいただきありがとうございます。よろしくお願いします。時間になったら始めさせていただきます
dialogue.content: Thank you for your time today. I'm looking forward to our session. We'll begin when it's time.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です。今日はお越し頂きありがとうございます。初めに、あなたの年齢、性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming in today. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 女子、17歳です
dialogue.content: Female, 17 years old.

dialogue.origin: 教えていただき、ありがとうございます。今日はどういったご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: ラインしてる友達のこと
dialogue.content: It's about friends I'm chatting with on LINE.

dialogue.origin: お友達のことで悩んでおられるのですね？どんなことか詳しく教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: I see, you're concerned about your friends. Could you tell me more about what's going on?

dialogue.origin: なんか最近、違和感感じてます
dialogue.content: Lately, I've been feeling that something's off.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、、、。どんなところに違和感を感じるのですか？
dialogue.content: I see. In what ways are you feeling that something is off?

dialogue.origin: 元々習い事で付き合い始めたグループなんだけど、
dialogue.content: Well, it's a group that originally formed through an extracurricular activity we did together,

dialogue.origin: ええ、
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: クラスが一緒の子もいるから、抜けるのも嫌だし、でも、楽しくなくなってきたりした
dialogue.content: Some of them are in my class at school, so I don't want to leave the group, but it's just not fun anymore.

dialogue.origin: えぇ、えぇ。他に知ってる子がいるとグループは抜けづらいですよね、
dialogue.content: I see, I see. It can be difficult to leave a group when you have other connections with the members, can't it?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どんなことが楽しくないと感じますか？
dialogue.content: What makes it feel not fun?

dialogue.origin: なんか、やりたいこととか、好みが違うような気がしてて、そう思う
dialogue.content: I feel like our interests and what we want to do are different now, and that's why.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。方向性が違うと、楽しくないなって思いますよね。
dialogue.content: I understand. When you feel like you're heading in different directions, it can certainly feel less enjoyable.

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: そのやりとりでは、どんなことを話されるのですか？
dialogue.content: What kinds of things do you talk about in your chats?

dialogue.origin: 将来の事とかです
dialogue.content: Things like our future.

dialogue.origin: 将来のお話をらされるんですね。具体的にどういったところに違いを感じるか教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: You talk about the future. Could you tell me specifically where you feel the differences lie?

dialogue.origin: ピアノ習ってた仲間なんだけど、、みんなは保育士さんとか、ピアノ関係の事やりたいみたい。だけど、なんか、興味ない
dialogue.content: We all took piano lessons together, and they all seem to want to do things related to piano, like becoming preschool teachers. But I'm just not interested in that.

dialogue.origin: えぇ、えぇ。やりたいことがみんなと違うんですね。
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm, I see. So what you want to do is different from everyone else.

dialogue.origin: そう
dialogue.content: Right.

dialogue.origin: その状況をあなたはどう思っているのですか？
dialogue.content: How do you feel about that situation?

dialogue.origin: なんか、盛り上がってるから、違和感感じてる
dialogue.content: Well, they get all excited about it, and I just feel out of place.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね…みんなが盛り上がってるのに、自分は興味がないから、その場所にいることに違和感を感じるのですね。
dialogue.content: I see... So while everyone else is excited, you're not interested, which makes you feel out of place being there.

dialogue.origin: 会わせるの疲れる
dialogue.content: It's tiring to pretend to go along with it.

dialogue.origin: それは寂しい思いをされますよね？はい、はい、
dialogue.content: That must make you feel lonely, doesn't it? Yes, I see.

dialogue.origin: 人に気を遣って合わせるのはとても疲れますよね…
dialogue.content: It's very tiring to have to be considerate of others and go along with them.

dialogue.origin: さびしいっていうか…疲れる
dialogue.content: It’s not so much lonely... just exhausting.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね…そう思うのも当然だと思いますよ。では、
dialogue.content: I see... I think it's completely natural to feel that way. So then,

dialogue.origin: あなたはその仲間についてどう思われてますか？
dialogue.content: how do you feel about your friends in the group?

dialogue.origin: 友だちだけならいいんだけど、お母さんたちはいまだにママ会とかしてて
dialogue.content: If it were just about us friends, it would be fine, but our mothers still have their own get-togethers.

dialogue.origin: はい、はい
dialogue.content: Yes, I see.

dialogue.origin: お母さんも勝手にテンション上げてるからウザい
dialogue.content: My mom also gets all hyped up on her own, and it’s annoying.

dialogue.origin: えぇ、えぇ。そうなんですね。お母さんたちとの繋がりもあって、そのような気持ちになるのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So the connection between the mothers is also contributing to how you feel.

dialogue.origin: 最近はお母さんから言われるのも、めんどくさい
dialogue.content: Lately, it's become a hassle to hear about it from my mom.

dialogue.origin: 自分のテンションと違うから、お母さんの行動を見て嫌気がさしちゃいますよね
dialogue.content: Because her excitement doesn't match your feelings, you've grown tired of seeing her act that way, haven't you?

dialogue.origin: はい、何を言われるのですか？
dialogue.content: Yes, what does she say?

dialogue.origin: なんか、私がピアノ教師になるとか、勝手に言ってる
dialogue.content: She just assumes I'm going to be a piano teacher and says so.

dialogue.origin: そんなことを！勝手に言われるのは迷惑ですよね…。
dialogue.content: She says that! It must be frustrating to have her decide that for you.

dialogue.origin: ウザいし、めんどくさい
dialogue.content: It’s annoying and a hassle.

dialogue.origin: えぇ、。それは確かにそう思いますよね。勝手なこと言ってムカつきますよね
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm. I can certainly see why you'd feel that way. It's upsetting when she says things like that without considering your feelings.

dialogue.origin: あなたとしてはそういっているお母さんに対してどんな行動をされたのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What have you done in response when your mother says those things?

dialogue.origin: 不機嫌な顔する
dialogue.content: I just make a sour face.

dialogue.origin: それでお母さんはどんな態度をされてますか？
dialogue.content: And how does your mother react to that?

dialogue.origin: 気づいてない
dialogue.content: She doesn't notice.

dialogue.origin: というか、気づこうとしてないのかも
dialogue.content: Or rather, maybe she’s not even trying to notice.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね…それはイライラしますよね。
dialogue.content: I see... That must be frustrating.

dialogue.origin: 気付こうとしてないとはどういうことですか？
dialogue.content: What do you mean by 'she's not trying to notice'?

dialogue.origin: 勝手に決めてるんでしょ、きっと
dialogue.content: She's probably already decided it all on her own.

dialogue.origin: 子供の頃とは違うのにさ
dialogue.content: Even though I'm not a child anymore.

dialogue.origin: あなたがピアノの教師になるということを勝手に決めて、あなたの気持ちを気づかないふりをしているということですか？
dialogue.content: So you feel she's decided on her own that you'll be a piano teacher and is pretending not to notice your feelings about it?

dialogue.origin: 本当にそうですよね…自分の気持ちや考えだってあるのに、勝手にテンション上がって言ってたらたら困りますよね…
dialogue.content: I can absolutely see that. You have your own feelings and thoughts, so it’s difficult when she just gets carried away and says things like that on her own.

dialogue.origin: わからないけど、確かに子供の頃はそう言ってたけど、
dialogue.content: I don't know, but it's true I used to say that when I was a kid.

dialogue.origin: えぇ、えぇ
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm, I see.

dialogue.origin: ずっとおんなじじゃない
dialogue.content: but I’m not the same anymore.

dialogue.origin: そう思われるのですね。では、あなたとしてはどんなことを望まれますか？お母さんに対して、そのグループに対して
dialogue.content: That's how you feel now. So, what would you like to see happen—with your mother, and with the group?

dialogue.origin: おかあさんには子供の時のままじゃないって言いたい、
dialogue.content: I want to tell my mom that I'm not a kid anymore.

dialogue.origin: グループは・・・
dialogue.content: As for the group...

dialogue.origin: 訴えても仕方ないかな
dialogue.content: I guess there's no point in complaining.

dialogue.origin: えぇ、えぇ。違うんだよって伝えたいですよね？
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm. You want to tell her that you're different now, right?

dialogue.origin: グループに関しては
dialogue.content: Regarding the group,

dialogue.origin: 訴えるのは違うと思うけど、そのグループから抜けるという選択をすることに関してはどう思いますか？
dialogue.content: I agree complaining might not be the way, but what about the option of leaving the group?

dialogue.origin: 抜けようとまでは思わない
dialogue.content: I don't feel like going as far as leaving.

dialogue.origin: えぇ、えぇ。お知り合いの仲間もいますもんね。
dialogue.content: I see. You do have other friends in there, after all.

dialogue.origin: では、合わせるのめんどくさいし、自分がいることに違和感を感じるとのことですが、そのことについてはどう思われますか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned it’s a hassle to go along with them and that you feel out of place being there. How do you feel about that?

dialogue.origin: う～ん・・・なんか、どんどんなんか違うな、と思ったりしてる
dialogue.content: Hmm... I increasingly feel like it’s not really for me.

dialogue.origin: なんか、女の子らしい感じがして…。
dialogue.content: It feels kind of girly...

dialogue.origin: ホントは自分に合わない気がしてる
dialogue.content: I feel like it doesn't really suit me.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、そういう気持ちをお持ちなのですね。
dialogue.content: I see, so that's how you're feeling.

dialogue.origin: あなたがそのグループに違和感を感じると言っていましたが、その他に一緒にいることであなたの支障になることや不安なことなどはありそうですか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned you feel out of place in the group. Besides that, are there any other obstacles or anxieties that come from being with them?

dialogue.origin: ホントにしたい話とかはできないかな
dialogue.content: I don't think I can talk about what I really want to talk about.

dialogue.origin: えぇ、えぇ。その中でそういう話ができる人を見つけるのは難しそうですよね。
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm. It does seem difficult to find someone in that group you can have those kinds of conversations with.

dialogue.origin: これまでお話を聞いて、
dialogue.content: Listening to what you've said so far,

dialogue.origin: そう
dialogue.content: Right.

dialogue.origin: 自分に合わないのではないか、方向性が違うから違和感を感じる…だけど、グループを離脱するのは違う気がする。というあなたの気持ちを拝見しました。
dialogue.content: I've heard your feelings: you feel it doesn't suit you and you feel out of place because your directions are different, but you also feel that leaving the group isn't the right choice.

dialogue.origin: わたしは、そのグループの中で、あなたなりの考えやあり方などを素直に持っていてもいいのではないかと思いますが…それぞれ考え方が違うのは当たり前ですし、それが自然なことです
dialogue.content: I think it's perfectly fine for you to have your own thoughts and be yourself within that group. It's natural for everyone to have different ways of thinking, and that's perfectly normal.

dialogue.origin: そして、
dialogue.content: And,

dialogue.origin: あなたが違和感を感じる、や合わせることがめんどくさいと思いなのも、当然な気持ちですよね。合わせなきゃいけないって思うのはどういうところから来るのでしょう？
dialogue.content: it's also a very natural feeling that you feel out of place and find it a hassle to go along with them. Where do you think this feeling that you have to fit in comes from?

dialogue.origin: まあ、自分も同じようなこと思ってた時期は確かにあったから…
dialogue.content: Well, there definitely was a time when I thought the same way they do...

dialogue.origin: はい、はい、
dialogue.content: Yes, I see.

dialogue.origin: なんか、今さら、今はそう思ってないって言いだしにくい空気が…
dialogue.content: It just feels like there's this atmosphere where it's hard to say that I don't think that way anymore...

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。それで将来性が変わったことをここでわざわざ言うのも気が引けますもんね。
dialogue.content: I see. You must feel hesitant to go out of your way to say that your future plans have changed.

dialogue.origin: グループの友達はあなたにどんなことを求めていると思いますか？
dialogue.content: What do you think your friends in the group expect from you?

dialogue.origin: そこまで考えてなんかいないと思います
dialogue.content: I don’t think they’ve thought that much about it.

dialogue.origin: 知るはずもないし
dialogue.content: There’s no way they would know.

dialogue.origin: 気づいても居ないと思う
dialogue.content: I don't think they've even noticed.

dialogue.origin: えぇ、えぇ。わたしもお話を聞いていてそう思いました。合わせることがあなたにとって負担になるなら無理に合わせる必要もないと思いますが、、、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm. I thought so too as I was listening to you. If trying to fit in is a burden for you, I don't think you need to force yourself to do it. What are your thoughts on that?

dialogue.origin: はい。合わせないには、どうしたらいいでしょう
dialogue.content: Okay. So what should I do to not have to go along with them?

dialogue.origin: 自分の方向性を真っ先に言うってのはとても簡単なことじゃないと思いますが…例えば、会話の中で自分が違うって思ったことに関して、私はこう思っているという気持ちを少しづつ伝えてみるとか…
dialogue.content: Outright stating that your direction has changed is not an easy thing to do, but for example, when something comes up in conversation that you feel differently about, you could try gradually sharing a little bit of your own thoughts, like, 'This is how I feel about it.'

dialogue.origin: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How does that sound?

dialogue.origin: 当分は見てるだけにしようかなでも
dialogue.content: Maybe for the time being, I'll just watch, though.

dialogue.origin: はい、はい。
dialogue.content: Okay, I see.

dialogue.origin: 何もコメントしないと、変だよね？
dialogue.content: But if I don't comment at all, that would be weird, right?

dialogue.origin: それもありだと思いますよ。様子を見て、自分から発信できそうな時を待つと言うのも一つの手だと思います。変ですかね？グループは何人いるんですか？
dialogue.content: I think that's also an option. Watching and waiting for a time when you feel you can speak up is one approach. Do you think it would be weird? How many people are in the group?

dialogue.origin: 5人です
dialogue.content: Five.

dialogue.origin: はい、その中でもしあなたが返事来ないってなったら、もし本当の友達なら気にかけてくる人はいると思いますし。
dialogue.content: I see. And if you don't reply, I think a true friend in the group would probably reach out to see if you're okay.

dialogue.origin: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How does that sound?

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's true.

dialogue.origin: 簡単ではないですが、あなたができることから少しづつやってみてください
dialogue.content: It's not easy, but please try to start with what you can, little by little.

dialogue.origin: 周りや自分を達観できるあなたならきっとできると思いますよ
dialogue.content: I'm sure you can do it, as you're someone who can look at yourself and your surroundings with perspective.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうしてみます
dialogue.content: Yes, I’ll try that.

dialogue.origin: そして、
dialogue.content: And,

dialogue.origin: お母さんには、自分が今までとは違うと言う思いをどのように伝えましょうか？
dialogue.content: regarding your mother, how shall we go about conveying the feeling that you're different now?

dialogue.origin: それが問題です
dialogue.content: That's the problem.

dialogue.origin: どのようなことが言いづらい気持ちにさせてますか？
dialogue.content: What makes it hard for you to say?

dialogue.origin: ホントは頭に来てるけど、申し訳ない気もして、うまく言えそうにない
dialogue.content: I'm actually angry, but I also feel bad, so I don't think I can say it well.

dialogue.origin: わざわざは言いにくいしな…
dialogue.content: And it's hard to bring it up out of the blue...

dialogue.origin: えぇ、えぇ。申し訳ない気持ちっていうのは具体的にどんな気持ちでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. Could you tell me more about that feeling of 'feeling bad'?

dialogue.origin: わざわざ時間を作って話をするのはとても勇気がいりますもんね
dialogue.content: It does take a lot of courage to set aside time specifically to have that talk, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: 小さい頃からママ友親子も一緒に楽しんできたし…でも、
dialogue.content: We've had fun together with the other mothers and their kids since we were little... but,

dialogue.origin: はい、
dialogue.content: Yes,

dialogue.origin: 勝手に言われたことは頭に来てる
dialogue.content: I'm still angry that she says things without asking me.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。勝手に言われるのは困りますよね。では、
dialogue.content: I understand. It's difficult when she decides things for you. Well then,

dialogue.origin: 直接は言いづらいとしたら、他にどのように伝える手段がありそうですか？
dialogue.content: If it's difficult to say it directly, what other ways might there be to communicate it?

dialogue.origin: なんだか、文字とかにするのはできそうもない気がしてきた
dialogue.content: Somehow, I don't feel like I could put it in writing, like in a text message, either.

dialogue.origin: 難しいですよね…まずは誰かに相談してみるってのも一つの手ですよね。
dialogue.content: It is difficult... One option is to try talking to someone else about it first.

dialogue.origin: だれか？
dialogue.content: Someone else?

dialogue.origin: どなたかにご相談されたましたか？
dialogue.content: Have you talked to anyone about this?

dialogue.origin: ここで初めて話しました
dialogue.content: This is the first time I’ve talked about it.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。例えば、ご家族の他の方に相談して、お母さんに伝えてもらうような協力の手を借りるとか…いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. For example, you could consult another family member and ask for their help in conveying the message to your mother. How does that sound?

dialogue.origin: 考えてもみませんでした
dialogue.content: I hadn't even thought of that.

dialogue.origin: えぇ。ご家族だと、あなたをよく知っている方なので理解してくださると思うのですが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm. Since a family member knows you well, I think they would be understanding. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: そっか、わかりました
dialogue.content: Oh, okay. I get it.

dialogue.origin: どなたならご相談できそうですか？
dialogue.content: Is there anyone you feel you could talk to?
My younger sister...

dialogue.origin: それは素敵ですね。いいとおもいますよ。
dialogue.content: That's wonderful. I think that's a great idea.

dialogue.origin: 今日、お話を聞いていてグループの子達やお母さんに気を遣う優しい気持ちがあるあなたなら、きっと周りの人達を優しい気持ちにしていける気がしました。
dialogue.content: Listening to you today, I felt that with your kind heart, being so considerate of your friends and your mother, you'll surely be able to make those around you feel that same kindness.

dialogue.origin: 妹さんにお話ししていい考えが浮かんだらまたお話し聞かせてくださいね。
dialogue.content: Talk to your sister, and if you come up with a good idea, please let me know how it goes.

dialogue.origin: はい、今日はありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much for today.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそありがとうございました。あなたの気持ちが伝わるように応援しておりますね。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well. I'll be rooting for you to get your feelings across.

dialogue.origin: (長い時間本当にすみませんでしたありがとうございました)
dialogue.content: (Thank you very much, and I apologize that the session ran long.)

dialogue.origin: (大変勉強になりました、ありがとうございました)
dialogue.content: (This was a great learning experience, thank you very much.)

dialogue.origin: (お疲れ様でした。失礼しますね)
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your hard work. I'll be going now.)

dialogue.origin: (こちらこそ勉強になりました。おつかれさまでした。それでは終了させていただきますね。)
dialogue.content: (It was a learning experience for me as well. Thank you for your hard work. I'll go ahead and conclude the session now.)

topic.sub: 友達の気持ちとのズレ
